wifi_memory.storage: Device NVS namespace ax900_wifi, up to four profiles; NVS encryption disabled in official demo
wifi_memory.save_policy: Only after authenticated DHCP; failed/diagnostic attempts do not replace working profiles
wifi_memory.reconnect_policy: Most recent matching saved network on boot; runtime recovery stays on the selected raw SSID/security. Up to five attempts with backoff; 60 seconds continuously connected resets budget. Manual disconnect, forget and authentication failures suppress recovery until explicit selection or reboot.
wifi_memory.hardware_failed_attempt: PEAP authentication failure on the installed image left saved profile count at zero

recovery_validation.internal_heap_note: After the first recovery, sampled free internal heap stayed within 48 bytes across the remaining cycles; short run only, not a long-duration leak guarantee.
recovery_validation.logs: Raw serial/build/flash logs and per-cycle measurements remain local in ignored logs directories; no log upload.
recovery_validation.limits: Controlled diagnostic faults; no physical unplug/replug, real AP outage, real DHCP-server outage, device-side STALL or throughput claim. The final release image disables fault injection.
